svg.aria-label: The same 1,000 real web PDFs made PDF/A: Ghostscript 10.08 labels 44 files PDF/A that fail veraPDF; fynepdf-pdfa labels none wrongly and makes 993 valid against Ghostscript's 928. Converting 2,053 files takes fynepdf-pdfa 96 seconds and Ghostscript 740: fynepdf-pdfa is done when Ghostscript has done 13%. Valid PDF/A, no false labels, 7.7 times faster than Ghostscript. Made by FynePDF.
